ModMetaData.name: Gas Ventilation Systems
ModMetaData.author: Xmaxer
ModMetaData.description:
Pipe four weaponised gases around your base with Vanilla Expanded Framework pipes.
Craft gas canisters, rack them in canister manifolds, and release the gas through wall, wall-mounted, ceiling or floor vents. Vents can be switched by hand or armed with an intruder sensor.
- Toxin gas: burns the lungs of organic, breathing creatures. - Sedative gas: knocks organic creatures unconscious. - Haywire gas: damages and scrambles mechanoids, drones, robots and androids. - Insecticide gas: slowly kills insectoids.
Gas spreads cell by cell like vanilla gas, is blocked by walls and closed doors, and creatures try to escape it.
Requires Harmony and Vanilla Expanded Framework. No DLC required.
